name: Commission Form
summary: Custom commission request form with reference image upload.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Commission-request composition container; targets choose the native form boundary.

anatomy.name: referenceUpload
anatomy.description: Optional File Upload composition region; it does not recreate file-input state.

anatomy.name: uploadLabel
anatomy.description: Legacy supporting upload copy outside the canonical File Upload state model.

states.name: default
states.description: Commission Form does not duplicate dependency states.

behavior.name: fieldComposition
behavior.description: Composed Input and Textarea dependencies own labels, values, disabled behavior, focus, and Default, Error, Success, and Warning validation families.

behavior.name: uploadComposition
behavior.description: The composed File Upload dependency owns native file selection, accepted-type guidance, disabled behavior, focus, and validation presentation.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: Composed Button dependencies own action emphasis, focus, disabled, and busy behavior.

behavior.name: workflowOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own field inventory, consent, submission, persistence, status responses, notifications, and the overall commission workflow.

properties.name: fields
properties.description: Target-owned canonical Input and Textarea composition.

accessibility: Use a native form when the target provides submission and associate every composed field with a visible label.
Composed Input, Textarea, and File Upload preserve Default, Error, Success, and Warning feedback, including aria-describedby and aria-invalid rules.
Do not duplicate dependency validation messages or state classes on Commission Form.
Composed Button actions preserve disabled and busy semantics.
Announce target-owned submission outcomes without moving focus unexpectedly.

web.notes: Layout composition is implemented in components/css/ceramics.css; workflow is target-owned.
